sentences.text: Anthropodyptes is a poorly known genus containing only one species of extinct penguin.
The only known species, Anthropodyptes gilli, is known from a Middle Miocene humerus found in Australia.
Anthropodyptes is classified within the family Spheniscidae.
Researchers suggest that Anthropodyptes might belong to the subfamily Palaeeudyptinae because its bones resemble those of the New Zealand genus Archaeospheniscus.
Anthropodyptes lived between 23.04 and 15.98 million years ago during the Aquitanian to Burdigalian stages.
